notes.title: "1f y0u're a gh0st ca11 me here!" Coming to multiple platforms on June 6, 2025!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40628395/328115ea7ce91b884750fd308e09f0a4158d98ff.png[/img]

"1f y0u're a gh0st ca11 me here!" is finally coming to multiple platforms!
This time, we were unable to include Chinese language support due to contractual obligations with the company we had previously partnered with before KEMCO.

There are no new scenarios or new illustrations this time.
This is because, as the director, I found it difficult to write a new scenario. I tried many times, but at this point, it proved impossible.
Therefore, I’ve decided to include a prequel focusing on Ars, Memento, and Vanitas when creating the sequel.

The content of the multiplatform release and the Steam version is the same, except for control adjustments.
This is because this game has been loved and nurtured by the Steam community, and I didn’t want to add any exclusive features.
Please enjoy the game on the platform you prefer!

It's all thanks to your support.
With heartfelt gratitude,
Director
Kotaro Dendaira

notes.title: Finally set to be released in the first half of 2025 on multiple platforms!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40628395/93f21238f97cf269142178b4da52e9a136c2d350.png[/img]
Thank you for waiting so long! The complete edition will be released on Nintendo Switch,Xbox Siries X,PS4 and PS5 in the first half of 2025! The publisher is KEMCO, a Japanese company!
[list]
[*] A prequel story about Ars and Memento
[*]  New event illustrations
[/list]
These will be added to the Steam version for free as an update, available at the same time as the Switch release.
I believe this game has been nurtured by our Steam users, and I would be grateful if you could accept our heartfelt thanks!
However, due to some issues with a Chinese company, the contract was terminated, so the Chinese language will not be available in the  Nintendo Switch,Xbox Siries X,PS4 and PS5 version. Since I want many players from Chinese-speaking regions to enjoy the game, I hope to work something out through further discussions.

Vanitas will try to master his craft by making 100 consecutive calls! And the more calls he clears, the more new stories will be released.

notes.title: The demo version is now available!
notes.notes:
The demo version has been released!
It is available in Japanese, English, and Chinese

There is a request when you start this game.
When you start the game, some programs may be caught by the virus scan
This is because some malicious software has been developed with the same name as the program that must be built into steam
[b]This game will not harm your PC, so please approve and launch it!
[/b]
Work with our protagonist Vanitas in a nice ghost call center!
